info.name: Sofar Ocean Spotter & Smart Mooring Devices API

params.name: excludeSharedDevices
params.description: Set true to limit the response to Spotters registered directly to your account.

items.docs: Retrieve a list containing the display name, Spotter ID, and hull type of any Spotters you have API access to (registered to or shared with your account), ordered by spotterId.
